title_zh: 马龙：乒乓球历史上的「大满贯」选手
title_en: Famous Chinese People (15/20): Ma Long, Table Tennis's "Grand Slam" Champion
note_en: 曾 (céng) before a verb means "once, at one time" and marks something as a past experience: 他曾连续多年排名世界第一 "he was ranked world number one for many years in a row." Unlike English, Chinese verbs have no past tense, so words like 曾 do the job; it is more formal than 过, and the two often go together (曾…过). Contrast 了, which marks a single completed action rather than past experience.
